summary: Completed testing of founder cards feature with frosted glass badges and mobile bottom bars. Found two critical issues: missing LinkedIn icons in both desktop badges and mobile bars, and desktop hover fade behavior not working correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing LinkedIn icons in frosted glass badges - icons should appear but are not displaying
Missing LinkedIn icons in mobile bottom bars - icons should appear but are not displaying

integration_issues.issue: Badge should fade out when hovering but stays visible - hover overlay appears correctly but badge doesn't fade as specified

passed_tests: Desktop frosted glass badges: All 3 founder badges always visible with correct names (Sunetra, Aditya, Shefali)
Desktop LinkedIn links: All badges link to correct LinkedIn profiles (sunetra-bhattacharya, adityabhatnagar1994, shefalitailor)
Mobile responsive behavior: Desktop badges correctly hidden on 375px viewport
Mobile bottom bars: All 3 mobile bars displaying with names and LinkedIn text
Mobile LinkedIn links: All mobile bars link to correct LinkedIn profiles
Mobile shimmer animation: Detected animation working on all 3 mobile bars
Hero section: Loading and displaying correctly
Countdown timer: Working with 4 time units (Days, Hrs, Min, Sec) displaying correctly
UPCOMING EVENTS title: Found and displaying properly in schedule section
Carousel: 18 items animating correctly in infinite loop
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix missing LinkedIn icons in both desktop badges and mobile bars. Also fix desktop hover behavior so badges fade out when hovering over founder cards.
success_percentage: frontend: 75% (core functionality working, missing icons and hover behavior need fixes)
